claim_boundary: C011 adds six inherited exact-certificate descendants. None is independently reviewed or claimed novel.

hypotheses.title: Rational LDL Certificate Completeness Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Every symmetric positive-semidefinite matrix with rational entries admits, after a rational permutation of coordinates, an exact factorization P Q P^T = L D L^T where L is unit lower triangular with rational entries and D is diagonal with nonnegative rational entries. A factorization can be constructed and verified using a polynomial number of exact rational operations, with encoded intermediate size polynomially bounded in the explicit matrix input size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Exact rational PSD certificates no longer require rational square roots or ordinary Gram factors, removing a certificate-language gap in H089 and enabling exact theta primal-dual verification.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: provide a complete rational PSD certificate language for H089 and the exact theta verifier H093.
hypotheses.next_gate: Complete the universal fraction-growth bound under one binary rational encoding and obtain independent review of the zero-pivot induction.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H092 replaces ordinary rational Gram factors by exact rational LDL certificates, which cover singular rational PSD matrices without adjoining square roots.
falsification_conditions: A rational PSD matrix admitting no rational permuted LDL decomposition with nonnegative diagonal.
A family of explicit rational PSD matrices forcing superpolynomial certificate or intermediate bit length relative to their encoded input size.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The executable constructor checks exact algebra. It is not an independent proof of the stated asymptotic bit bound.

hypotheses.title: Exact Lovasz-Theta Primal-Dual Certificate Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: For the fixed SDP maximize <J,X> subject to Tr(X)=1, X_ij=0 on graph edges, and X positive semidefinite, a rational primal matrix and rational dual slack, each supplied with an exact H092 LDL certificate and equal rational objective values, form a deterministic polynomial-time verifiable certificate of the exact Lovasz theta value.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H087 and H096 can demand exact machine-checkable theta values rather than trusting floating-point solver output.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: turn H089 and H092 into an exact primal-dual theta certificate format with no numerical tolerance.
hypotheses.next_gate: Independently audit the chosen edge-constraint normalization and integrate a certificate generated by an external SDP-to-rational reconstruction pipeline.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H093 combines exact LDL positivity with one fixed primal-dual Lovasz-theta formulation and exact objective equality.
falsification_conditions: A certificate accepted by the verifier whose claimed value is not the optimum of the stated SDP.
A valid rational primal-dual pair in the stated format that the verifier rejects despite exact equality and feasibility.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma verifies supplied rational certificates; it does not promise that the optimum is rational or that such a pair can always be found efficiently.

hypotheses.title: Dual Theta-Gap UNSAT Certificate Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: For a clause-literal conflict graph of a CNF with m clauses, any rational H093-style dual feasible certificate with objective t<m is an exact certificate that the CNF is unsatisfiable, because alpha(G) is at most theta(G), theta(G) is at most t, and satisfiability would require alpha(G)=m.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The constructive side of H070 needs only produce a one-sided rational dual gap below m; exact theta optimization and a primal witness are unnecessary for UNSAT certification.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: isolate a polynomially checkable one-sided UNSAT certificate from the broader theta-gap compiler route.
hypotheses.next_gate: Bind the dual certificate to a canonical conflict-graph hash and externally reproduce one nontrivial CNF certificate with a rational gap.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H094 extracts the one-sided consequence needed for SAT: a verified rational dual upper bound below the clause target certifies UNSAT without computing the exact optimum.
falsification_conditions: A satisfiable CNF whose correctly constructed conflict graph admits a valid dual theta upper bound strictly below its clause count.
A mismatch between the certified graph and the CNF from which the clause target is claimed.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Failure to obtain a gap says nothing about satisfiability. The certificate is one-sided and does not make ordinary theta a complete SAT algorithm.

hypotheses.title: Disjoint-Union Theta Seed Amplification Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: If two disjoint-variable CNFs with the same clause count have opposite satisfiability labels and conflict graphs with the same Lovasz theta value, then taking r disjoint renamed copies of each produces explicit polynomial-size SAT and UNSAT families with equal clause counts and equal theta values for every r, using additivity of alpha and theta under graph disjoint union.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H087 and H096 need only find one finite certified collision seed; the infinite-family requirement can be discharged separately and uniformly.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: amplify one exact finite theta collision into the explicit asymptotic family required by the bounded-theta obstruction route.
hypotheses.next_gate: Write a complete proof of theta additivity under the exact SDP convention used by H093 and obtain independent review of the CNF variable-renaming reduction.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H095 adds the disjoint-union amplification step required to turn one certified finite collision seed into an explicit infinite family.
falsification_conditions: A counterexample to Lovasz-theta additivity under disjoint union for the H093 convention.
Cross-component conflict edges remaining after the stipulated disjoint variable renaming.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The code checks graph disjointness and alpha additivity on finite fixtures; theta additivity remains a mathematical proof obligation.

hypotheses.title: Certified Finite Level-One Theta Collision Seed Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a finite pair of clause-literal conflict graphs with the same positive clause target, opposite exact alpha labels relative to that target, and equal exact Lovasz theta values certified by H093 rational primal-dual bundles.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Together with H095, one finite machine-checkable seed yields an explicit infinite SAT/UNSAT family invisible to the standard first theta level.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: replace H087's broad family search by the smallest exact finite certificate bundle that would suffice after amplification.
hypotheses.next_gate: Enumerate small canonical CNFs, obtain externally generated theta certificates, rationally reconstruct them, and pass the exact collision-bundle verifier.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H096 replaces the broad twin conjecture by one finite bundle with exact alpha diagnostics, exact primal-dual theta certificates, equal targets, and opposite SAT labels.
falsification_conditions: A theorem that theta(G)=m implies alpha(G)=m for every clause-literal conflict graph with m clause cliques.
Exhaustion of all finite graphs together with such a theorem, not merely a bounded computational search.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No collision seed is currently registered. The verifier self-test deliberately rejects a non-collision pair and does not fabricate a positive witness.

hypotheses.title: Conditioned Polynomial-Bit Theta Certificate Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For rational graph SDPs in the fixed H093 formulation, if explicit primal and dual Slater margins and an objective separation margin are each at least inverse polynomial in the encoded instance size, then there exist rational dual certificates achieving a comparable gap whose total H092 LDL encoding length is polynomial in the instance size and logarithm of the inverse margins.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Under the conditioning promises already isolated by H081, a numerical theta gap can be converted into an exact polynomial-size H094 UNSAT certificate.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: close the remaining existence gap between well-conditioned numerical SDP solutions and exact rational certificate verification.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove a rational approximation theorem preserving dual feasibility and objective gap, with explicit dimension and bit-length constants.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H097 isolates the remaining certificate-existence question under explicit Slater and objective margins after exact verification has been solved.
falsification_conditions: A well-conditioned rational theta SDP with inverse-polynomial margins but requiring superpolynomial rational certificate bit length for every comparable dual bound.
A rounding obstruction that destroys PSD feasibility despite the stated strict dual margin.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture excludes weakly feasible and exponentially ill-conditioned SDPs; it does not claim short certificates without explicit margins.
